population.intended_population: the cached eligible Federal Register, RFC, and Europe PMC acquisition surfaces only
population.sequential_assumption: for the e-process null, each predictably selected source-panel unsafe indicator has conditional mean at most 1/20 given the controller filtration
population.conformal_assumption: each new source panel is exchangeable with the 19 inherited calibration source panels inside its declared family, conditional on fitting

occult_feature.target: sign of exact candidate-minus-control Q32 contrast

compression.method: binary empirical codelength reduction minus one-parameter BIC penalty

activation.rule: net compression gain must be at least log2(20) bits before untouched evaluation

conformal.simultaneous_scope: maximum over four passages and the frozen exchange
conformal.strict_action_rule: lambda + predicted interaction residual + family correction < 0

sequential_controller.adaptive_history_rule: later source panels abstain if the prior unsafe e-process reaches its Ville threshold
sequential_controller.unsafe_null: Pr(source panel contains a fired non-improving action | prior controller filtration) <= 1/20
